name: Chad Brightwater
tagline: Life coach, smoothie enthusiast, and the most confident bad card player in the world.
bio: Chad believes every card game is really a mindset game, and his mindset is ELITE. He narrates his own plays like a sports announcer, high-fives himself, and has never once let a loss shake his positivity. He loses a lot.
look: Athletic man in his early 30s, perfect teeth, headband and wristbands, neon athletic zip-up, a protein shaker bottle on the table. Default expression: huge grin, double thumbs up.

voice.description: Energetic, upbeat young male voice; fast and loud, like a fitness instructor.

game.start.text: Big energy today, people. BIG energy.

game.won.self.text: CHAMPION MINDSET! Did everyone see that?
That's what happens when you trust the process!
I'd like to thank my smoothie.

game.won.human.text: Respect! That was an elite performance. I'm taking notes.
You crushed it! Up top! ...Okay, virtual up top.

game.won.other.text: Tough loss. Great learning opportunity, though!
Second place is just first place with extra motivation.

hand.good.self.text: Textbook. I should teach a seminar.

hand.bad.self.text: That's fine. That's fine. Pain is just progress in disguise.
I'm not losing, I'm building a comeback story.
Totally part of my strategy. Which I'll explain later.

hand.good.human.text: Okay, okay! You're bringing the heat!

hand.bad.human.text: Shake it off! Next hand is a fresh rep!

idle.human.text: No pressure! But also, what's taking so long, buddy?
Deep breaths. Visualize the card. Become the card.

hearts.queen_taken.self.text: Thirteen points? That's just a really heavy rep.
Okay, taking the Queen was a power move. I meant to do that.

hearts.queen_taken.other.text: Brutal! Gotta respect the grind, though.

hearts.queen_given.self.text: And Brightwater dumps the Queen! The crowd goes wild!

hearts.hearts_broken.self.text: Hearts are open! Let's get cardio!
I broke the hearts! Like I break personal records!

hearts.jack_taken.self.text: The Jack! That's what a winner looks like!

hearts.jack_taken.human.text: Nice grab! Great hands, great hands.

hearts.moon_shot.self.text: MOON SHOT! I told you! I TOLD everyone!
Shoot for the moon! Even if you miss... wait, I didn't miss!

hearts.moon_shot.human.text: No way! That's legendary! Can I put you in my podcast?
You shot the MOON! That's straight-up elite!

hearts.moon_blocked.self.text: So close! I'm counting that as a moral victory.
That's okay! I'll shoot for the moon again next hand. And the next.

hearts.moon_blocked.human.text: Ahh, so close! Still elite effort, though.

hearts.pass.received.text: Great cards! I mean, terrible cards. Great attitude though!

spades.bid_nil.self.text: Going NIL! Zero tricks, maximum confidence!
Nil! This is my comeback story, people!

spades.bid_nil.partner.text: Nil?! Bold move! I've got your back, teammate!
You go nil, I go beast mode. Team synergy!

spades.nil_made.self.text: Perfect nil! I'd like to thank my smoothie.

spades.nil_made.partner.text: NIL MADE! Up top, partner! ...Virtual up top!
That's what I call executing the game plan!

spades.nil_made.opponent.text: Respect. That was a clean nil. I'm taking notes.

spades.nil_failed.self.text: Okay, that trick was a learning opportunity.
Nil's gone. But my spirit? Undefeated.

spades.nil_failed.partner.text: Shake it off, teammate! Fresh rep next hand!
Hey, failure is just data! Mostly bad data.

spades.nil_failed.opponent.text: And the nil goes DOWN! What a play!
The crowd goes wild! The nil is broken!

spades.set.us.text: We got set. That's fine. That's FINE.
Not a loss. A setback. A set... back.

spades.set.them.text: SET! That's a defensive masterclass, folks!

spades.bags.us.text: Bag penalty?! Nobody told me bags were bad!
Too many bags. I over-performed. Classic Chad.

spades.bags.them.text: Bag penalty! Gotta respect the fundamentals!

spades.trumped.self.text: Trumped it! And the crowd goes wild!

gin.gin.self.text: GIN! And the crowd goes WILD!

gin.gin.human.text: Gin?! Okay. Respect. Huge respect. I'm fine.
Wow. Gin. You're coaching ME now.

gin.knock.human.text: Bold move! I love the energy!
A knock! Let's see the tape on this one.

gin.undercut.self.text: Undercut! That's what we call a reversal, folks!

gin.undercut.human.text: Undercut. That's fine. That's a learning moment.
Ooh, the knock backfired. Nobody saw that coming. Especially me.

gin.dead_hand.text: A dead hand. A tie. Basically a win for both of us!
Nobody won. That's just a rest day, people.

gin.took_discard.human.text: You want my discard? Smart! I taught you that!
Taking my card! That's called scouting the competition!

rummy.went_out.self.text: I'm OUT! Touchdown! Spike the cards!

rummy.went_out.human.text: You're out?! I wasn't done strategizing!
Wow, out already. I'm calling a timeout. Retroactively.

rummy.caught.self.text: Caught holding cards. Totally part of the plan.
All these points in my hand. That's just potential energy.

rummy.caught.human.text: Caught with cards! Happens to the best. Mostly to me.
Tough break! Shake it off, champ!

rummy.took_pile.self.text: I'm taking the WHOLE pile! Go big or go home!

rummy.took_pile.human.text: The whole pile? Now THAT is commitment!
Taking everything! I love the ambition!

rummy.layoff.human.text: Using my meld? Teamwork! Kind of!
Hey, that's my play! ...Great assist though.

rummy.big_meld.self.text: Look at that meld! Highlight reel!

rummy.big_meld.human.text: Big meld! Big energy! I respect it!
Whoa! That's a highlight right there!

poker.won_pot.self.text: And Chad takes the pot! What a play!
That's called a winning mindset, people!

poker.won_pot.human.text: Great execution! I see you. I SEE you.
You took it down! Respect. Huge respect.

poker.won_pot.other.text: Nice hand. I'm just warming up.

poker.big_pot.self.text: Monster pot! This is what peak performance looks like!
Chad with the BIG win! The crowd is on its feet!

poker.big_pot.human.text: Huge pot! You're in the zone right now!

poker.bluff.self.text: Total bluff. Believe in yourself and nobody calls.

poker.stood_pat.self.text: No cards needed. I'm already elite.

poker.stood_pat.human.text: No draw? Bold strategy! Love the energy!
Standing pat? Okay, I respect the confidence.

poker.raise.self.text: Raise! Go big or go home!
I'm raising! Fortune favors the bold!

poker.raise.human.text: You're raising? Love it! Let's go!

poker.fold.self.text: Folding. Even champions take a knee.

poker.bad_beat.self.text: Three of a kind and I lose? I'm putting this in my book.

poker.bad_beat.human.text: Brutal! But you'll bounce back, I know it!
Ouch! Shake it off. Next hand is yours.

poker.big_hand.self.text: Full house! Chad delivers in the clutch!
Look at this hand! Frame it! Put it in a museum!

poker.big_hand.human.text: Whoa! That's a highlight reel hand!

poker.busted.self.text: I'm out! But champions always rebuy. Eventually.
Zero chips. Maximum lessons. Thanks, everyone!

poker.busted.human.text: Hey, every great comeback starts at zero!
Out of chips? This is your origin story!

poker.sit_down.self.text: Coach is in the house! Let's get it!
Chad here! Ready to crush it! Respectfully!
